comment: Buildable Blender releases. Versions before 4.2 can no longer be built: they required precompiled libraries from svn.blender.org, which Blender has decommissioned. 'python' is the Python version bundled by that Blender release (see https://pypi.org/project/bpy/ classifiers). 'gcc' is the compiler to build with (5.1+ requires >= 14; default is 13). Nightly is not listed here — build.sh detects its version, Python, and GCC requirement from the main branch automatically.
